primary_risk.name: phi_star sign flip
primary_risk.description: CLM v4 baseline +41.86 (G3 PASS-positive). SFT chat objective changes substrate; phi_star may flip negative — irreversible without retrain.
mitigation_layers: L2: post-train remeasure every hyperparam combo via anima_phi_v3_canonical
L3: delta regularizer = hard floor at threshold=5.0 during train (8x safety)
L4: LoRA-only mode preserves frozen base => phi_star structurally bounded
L5: early-stop trigger if phi_star EMA drops below 10.0 (2x threshold)

strategies.name: LoRA-only (recommended)
strategies.description: frozen base + LoRA r=64 a=128 delta — base phi_star structurally preserved

strategies.name: Full SFT + heavy delta regularizer
strategies.description: all params trainable, delta in [1.0, 2.0]; higher chat ceiling, higher phi flip risk

strategies.name: Hyperparameter sweep (9 LHS runs of S1)
strategies.description: best-of-9 on LoRA-only — phi_risk LOW (best run selected)

strategies.name: Differential pretrain (P3 sister-path)
strategies.description: from-scratch pretrain mixing cell-language + chat objectives; born-with-chat

rationale: Best success probability (0.70-0.90) at LOW phi_risk; cost in user-quoted band ($1000-3000).
